products.title: Women's Dress Test
products.body_html:
• • Navy umbrella
    • Printed reflective ALD Golf logo
    • Includes umbrella case
    • Canopy: 100% Coated Polyester
    • Frame: 43% Nylon, 35% PPA, 22% TPU
    • Drying: Allow umbrella to completely dry fully open to reduce the chance of mildew and stains forming.
    • Storing: Store umbrella in its sleeve to avoid nicks, holes, or scuffs.
    • Cleaning: Wipe clean with warm water & cloth. Avoid chemical detergents & bristle brushes. Wipe shaft with damp cloth regularly.
    • Made in China
  • Arc measures 57.5” open
    Total length measures 39”
